findings.message: 第 4 节把 Theorem thm:zero 说成「解释了为什么只有这三个方向能竞争」，但 thm:zero 只覆盖「至少一个坐标为 0」的法向，对三个坐标都非零的法向没有给出任何结论，这句话的强度超过它引的证据。
findings.evidence: main.tex 第 185 行逐字：「the result of Theorem~\ref{thm:zero} explains why only these three directions can compete: for normals with a vanishing coordinate the area is an explicit decreasing function of $|a|^p+|b|^p$, so within that class the extremum is always at a coordinate vector or at the face diagonal, never in between.」而 thm:zero（main.tex 第 97–115 行；台账 stmt:000035）的前提是「at least one coordinate equal to 0」；三个坐标都非零的情形在本文里只有附录 A（行 218–224）的数值读数，正文第 4 节同一页自己也承认「the absence of a strictly interior maximizing direction is only verified numerically」（行 183）。同一节行 193 还把它列为 open problem (a)。

result.data: The contributions of this note are the following. Section~2 fixes the notation. Section~3 proves four statements about the section area: an integral representation valid for all normals together with the coordinate and face-diagonal closed forms (Theorem~\ref{thm:integral}); the exact formula for normals with a vanishing coordinate and the resulting comparison with the coordinate direction (Theorem~\ref{thm:zero}); the integral representation, the special values and the continuity of the body-diagonal area (Theorem~\ref{thm:diag}); and the continuity and the two endpoint signs of the difference between the face-diagonal and the body-diagonal areas (Theorem~\ref{thm:delta}). Section~4 describes the numerically supported three-regime picture, states it as a conjecture rather than a theorem, discusses the relation with \cite{ball,konig,grzaslewicz,critical,eskenazis} and lists the open problems. Appendix~A documents the computations behind the numerical statements.
